summary: This bill nullifies a final rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency that established new performance standards and emission guidelines for greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuel-fired power plants and repealed the Affordable Clean Energy Rule.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly nullifies an EPA rule that establishes performance standards and emission guidelines for greenhouse gas emissions from fossil fuel-fired electric generating units. By removing these regulations, the bill directly reduces environmental protection related to climate change, making it central to the bill's purpose.
